object.attr: derived: review Q11 merged with CF-V21 (D-V15). Without it an agent commits source code or other non-document files, perhaps on instructions planted in a description, which validation can't check. Covers a path outside the repository, inside .git, or naming nothing.
object.description: If a path given to `commit_changes` lies in no document folder of the working copy or the latest commit, or names nothing in either, the MCP server shall refuse the commit and name the path.
